description: Defines classes and logic for managing clients sharing resources, including eviction policies, priorities, and client descriptors within Android's resource management system.

classes.name: ClientPriority
classes.description: Represents the priority of a client, including score, state, and vendor status.

classes.name: ClientDescriptor
classes.description: Container for client resource identification, cost, priority, owner, and conflicts.

classes.name: DefaultEventListener
classes.description: Default implementation of event listener interface for client add/remove events.

classes.name: ClientManager
classes.description: Manages a list of active clients, handles eviction, updates, and notifications.

methods.name: addAndEvict
methods.description: Adds a client descriptor, evicting others if necessary.

methods.name: updatePriorities
methods.description: Updates priorities of clients based on owner mappings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a client descriptor by key.

methods.name: waitUntilRemoved
methods.description: Blocks until a client is removed or timeout occurs.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the event listener for client add/remove events.
